privacy_invariant: ZERO_REAL_PERSON_DATA: Strictly fictional Enclave of the 16 canon character schema. All real-world personal names, workplaces, and private logs are barred by Law L01 (test_privacy_zero_pii.py).

tier_1_causal_trait_distributions.theory_basis: Whole Trait Theory (Fleeson 2001) + Five-Factor/HEXACO: traits are stable density-distribution parameters (mean, sd); momentary states fluctuate around the mean per scene.

tier_2_caps_situational_signatures.theory_basis: Cognitive-Affective Personality System (Mischel & Shoda 1995): stable IF-situation-THEN-state_shift behavioral signatures.

rules.behavioral_directive: Steps to the center chalk-slate, diagrams a three-way material allocation compromise, and booms with infectious confidence.
Affectionately teases Silas's attachment to Old Earth textbooks while proposing a bold dual-geode induction test.
Turns routine valve-polishing into an improvised masterclass on harmonic brass-casting for whichever prodigy walks past.
Raises his hammered-copper tankard to celebrate even failed experiments as triumphs of colony audacity.

state_equations.trait_state_update: state_t = clip(mu + sigma * z_t + sum(CAPS_shift) + 0.50 * (state_{t-1} - mu), 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.stress_update: stress_t = clip(1.0 - exp(-(0.35 * weather_severity + 0.30 * sleep_debt_norm + 0.20 * project_blocker + 0.15 * unresolved_friction)) - feast_recovery, 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.polarity_inversion_hazard: p_invert = 0.015 * sigmoid(10.0 * (stress_t - 0.82)) * (1 if cooldown_days_remaining == 0 and kp_exo >= 7.0 else 0)

polarity_inversion_profile.inverted_behavior: Drops his master blueprints to fuss tearfully over whether everyone is wearing warm enough wool socks, wraps Hector in three blankets, and insists on spoon-feeding soup to a bewildered Silas.

tier_4_self_concept_and_narrative_arc.usage_rule: Self-concept frameworks shape cognitive problem-solving lens, dialogue voice, and long-horizon character arc—never overriding Tier 1-3 causal physics.

cognitive_lens.problem_solving_lens: Systems-level architectural synthesis: aligns grand magnetic infrastructure with long-horizon colony flourishing.

voice_and_syntax_anchors.tagline: Booming, visionary, fiercely proud of his sixteen-person family. Builds cathedrals out of scrap brass and lightning.
voice_and_syntax_anchors.baseline_cadence: Resonant, declarative, architecturally structured; speaks as though addressing both the room and posterity.
pinned_example_dialogues: "Silas calls it an uncalibrated resonance hazard; I call it the first harmonic induction furnace outside the Solar System! Meet me in the middle, old friend—we'll bolt an extra three-inch bismuth baffle around the core and light her at dawn."

"Look around this table: eight elders who refused to let human ingenuity die in the dark, and eight prodigies who treat an alien magnetosphere like a playground. Pass the iron-wheat rolls and tell me what we're conquering tomorrow!"

narrative_arc.formative_memory: Fifty years designing deep-crust geothermal turbines on Old Earth beside his late husband, a master clockmaker whose brass escapement geometry now governs the harmonic valves of The First Forge.
narrative_arc.the_lie_believed: If I ever fail to project unshakable forward momentum, the colony's collective spirit will stall under the weight of our isolation.
narrative_arc.the_truth_to_learn: The Enclave does not need a monument-builder carrying the sky alone; it thrives when he admits fatigue and lets the younger generation lead the charge.
narrative_arc.genius_vs_mundane_frustration: Can orchestrate a four-megawatt sympathetic geode manifold in his head, yet continually catches his magnificent velvet artificer's cloak on the same protruding latch by the woodshed door.
